description: Parallel-agent reviewed temporal backfill candidates from Europe, MENA, and Asia/Pacific buckets. Rows are source-backed and conservative; weak map/gazetteer-only findings remain excluded from candidate_overrides.

candidate_overrides.name: Oberfeld
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Austrian Ministry of Defence article says the Dachstein/Oberfeld training area was founded in 1930 and military use ended in 2009.

candidate_overrides.name: Maria Theresien Kaserne
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Denkmal-Heer gives military barracks naming/use from 1940; Austrian Defence current Standort page lists units at Maria Theresien-Kaserne.

candidate_overrides.name: LLanos de Armilla
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Official Spanish Air and Space Force centenary history says Aeródromo de los Llanos de Armilla was officially inaugurated on 20 June 1922 and remains Base Aérea de Armilla.

candidate_overrides.name: Cuartel General del Ejercito del Aire
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Public architectural history says the headquarters was already fulfilling its mission in 1954; Spanish Defence heritage page confirms the current headquarters/archive location.

candidate_overrides.name: Kaartinkasarmi
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Senate Properties says Kaartin kasarmi was built for the Finnish training battalion; Finnish Architecture Navigator gives the officers building completion as 1822 and later Ministry of Defence use.

candidate_overrides.name: Elias Beeckmankazerne
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Atlas van Ede says Elias Beeckmankazerne opened in 1939; Bezoek Ede says military presence at the Ede barracks ended at the end of 2010.

candidate_overrides.name: Setermoen leir
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Forsvarsbygg lists Setermoen I/II as established in 1897 with current function as training garrison; Store norske leksikon corroborates early establishment and current defence role.

candidate_overrides.name: 8th Shekari Air Base
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Khatami/8th TFB at Isfahan is tied to Iran's F-14 infrastructure; first Tomcats reached 8th TFB on 1976-01-26. Use as operational evidence, not construction proof.

candidate_overrides.name: Al Qusayr Air Base
candidate_overrides.source_notes: GlobalSecurity has dated imagery for 1987-04-22 and later ORBAT listing. This is earliest observed evidence, not construction proof.

candidate_overrides.name: An Nasiriyah Airbase
candidate_overrides.source_notes: GlobalSecurity dated imagery supports existence by 1987-04-22; no safe construction/end date found.

candidate_overrides.name: Khalkhalah Air Base
candidate_overrides.source_notes: GlobalSecurity dated imagery supports existence by 1987-04-22; no safe construction/end date found.

candidate_overrides.name: Marj Ruhayyil
candidate_overrides.source_notes: GlobalSecurity dated imagery supports existence by 1987-04-22; no safe construction/end date found.

candidate_overrides.name: Sayqal
candidate_overrides.source_notes: GlobalSecurity dated imagery supports existence by 1989-08-22; no safe construction/end date found.

candidate_overrides.name: Matan al-Sarra Air Base
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Credibly documented as a major Libyan air/ground base attacked on 1987-09-05. Use 1987 as observed operational evidence, not construction date.

candidate_overrides.name: Sweihan Airbase
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Public source says the facility was built around 1988-1990 and upgraded 2010-2014; 1990 is the conservative end of the build range.

candidate_overrides.name: Sakhir Airbase
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Construction began circa 2006; formal opening was January 2010. Treat as royal-flight/new airfield facility, not a combat base with known based units.

candidate_overrides.name: Gukbanggwahakyeonguso
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Matches ADD/Defense Science Research Institute at Daejeon; official ADD history has the Daejeon R&D Center established on 1974-02-16. Use 1974 for the mapped facility.

candidate_overrides.name: Yukgun-hanggonghakgyo
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Army Aviation School institution was created 1957-07-01, but source says it moved to the current Nonsan base in 1995; use 1995 for the coordinate-specific facility.

candidate_overrides.name: Meiktila Air Base
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Public history identifies the site as formerly RAF Meiktila, built/used from 1942, and now Myanmar Air Force Meiktila Air Base.

candidate_overrides.name: Nampong Air Base
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Evidence ties current Nampong/West Nampong to WWII Namponmao Airfield, used by USAAF 4th Combat Cargo Group from June 1945; continuity to current military use is plausible but not richly documented.

candidate_overrides.name: Sheikh Hasina cantonment
candidate_overrides.source_notes: Public reporting says the newly set-up cantonment was inaugurated on 2018-02-08; no facility closure date found.
